    b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
)
newb=b[:idx]+insert+b[idx:]
out.write_bytes(newb)
# checks
written=out.read_bytes()
assert written==newb

assert written[idx+len(insert):]==b[idx:]

print('robots_meta_count_pattern',count_robot)
# show insertion context
start=max(0, idx-40)
end=min(len(written), idx+len(insert)+40)
